decision_metadata.llm_rationale: UP_TRI dominates the signal mix at 93/101 = 92.1% (above the 0.85 threshold), and when combined with BULL_PROXY the book is 98/101 = 97.0% directional-long — effectively a monoculture. Regime concentration (Bull 70.3%) and the top cell (UP_TRI×Bull×Bank at 13.86%) are within their respective thresholds, but the matched Bull×UP_TRI cohort sits only at Candidate tier (n=87) — unvalidated edge. Signal-type monoculture on an unvalidated cohort with recently-established Bull regime is the persistent actionable risk (extending a multi-week warn streak).
